notes: Heuristic path rules for discovering cosmetic resources. They are NOT derived from the game's data tables and must be treated as guesses; every discovered item starts as Experimental or Unknown.

Pet.reason: Only replaces the art of a pet that is already summoned; the server must spawn a pet you own.

WingsAndBack.reason: Needs an equipped back attachment to replace; nothing is drawn when the slot is empty.

FootprintsAndTrails.reason: Needs equipped footprints to replace; base characters have no footprint effect.

CharacterEffect.reason: Needs an equipped character effect to replace.

SkillAudio.reason: Skill sounds live inside FMOD .bank files; bank editing is not implemented.

Portal.reason: The default portal is always loaded, so a resource swap is possible; dependency closure must resolve.

SkillEffect.reason: Skill-to-resource mapping is heuristic until data tables are parsed.

*.reason: Discovered by path heuristics; verify dependencies before applying.
